questions: What is the mass of the reaction wheel?
How much does the satellite weigh?
What is mounted on the +X panel?
How many solar arrays does the satellite have?
What voltage does the OBC operate at?
Is the reaction wheel an actuator?
How long is the mission lifetime?
Which actuator is mounted on the +X panel?
What is the mass of the spacecraft?
text:
AquaSat is a small Earth observation satellite. The satellite has a total mass of 250 kg and carries two solar arrays. It was launched in March 2021 from Kourou.

The Attitude and Orbit Control System (AOCS) uses actuators such as reaction wheels and magnetorquers. The reaction wheel (RW) has a mass of 2,500 g. The RW is mounted on the +X panel and connected to the On-Board Computer (OBC). Reaction wheels are manufactured by Rockwell Collins. The OBC shall operate at 28 V and shall not consume more than 15 W. The Power Conditioning and Distribution Unit (PCDU) distributes power to all subsystems. The payload does not exceed 120 W. The mission has a lifetime of 5 years. The satellite orbits at an altitude of 600 km.
